method: No climb MAP inputs: ideal, isentropic inlet-total-pressure ratio p0=p(1+0.2M^2)^3.5 at sourced full-throttle critical point; regulator caps rated MAP; speed-dependent BHP proportional to predicted manifold pressure relative to measured maximum-speed TAS, or explicit engine-chart rated MAP when no exact-altitude speed anchor exists.

mustang2200Ft.interpretation: 75-inHg low-gear CLIMB critical altitude is 2,200ft in the original report; the LEVEL-FLIGHT 75-inHg low-gear critical altitude is 7,400ft. At representative climb TAS 195mph the modeled regulator holds full MAP. The climb residual remains in prop/drag/weight/engine chart, not a demonstrated ram-pressure shortfall. Source climb TAS unreported; modeled optimum and takeoff mass are assumptions.

originalP51B1Control.use: Independent qualitative/pressure-regulation boundary; different engine/airframe, no published TAS for these climb rows so exact speed-specific power is not reconstructed.
